scientific_integrity.proved_scope: Complete component-shape classification and exact labelled counts for every integer n>=4.
scientific_integrity.source_credit: The minimum cardinality formula is credited to Cornet, Dravec, Torres (2026), Theorem 14; no claim of rediscovering it.
scientific_integrity.unproved_or_unverified: Independent review and comprehensive historical-priority verification not performed.

scientific_limitations: Applies to minimum total dominating sets of J(n,2), n>=4, not all total dominating sets or J(n,k) for k>=3.
Historical priority remains contingent on indexing and literature under total edge domination of complete graphs.
Exhaustive computer checks cover n=4..10; the infinite statement uses a separate mathematical proof.
title: Complete census of minimum total dominating sets in triangular graphs
